triplet: The Contrast Collider: attraction is no accident; strengths and weaknesses violently clash.

Rebellion Over Order: individual love over collective expectation; world burns, heart beats.
The Contemporary Grind: two hamsters on separate treadmills, glancing at each other.

The Big Misunderstanding: misunderstandings grow logically from false protection mechanisms.
The Comedy Shield: witty banter is armor, a desperate tactic to avoid being truly vulnerable.

The Paranormal Taboo: stronger entity must intentionally weaken, or just power-fantasy.
The Second-Chance Cost: second chance more expensive than first; characters must risk more.
The Dark Romance Dungeon: sex as power struggle, healing or destruction; trauma follows.
The Masked Protagonist: highly competent externally, totally vulnerable in love.
The Love Interest: own wound, fear of commitment, false loyalty; they are not just a prop.
The Blocker: Ex, Career, Society; temptation of safety over the work of true love.
The Mentor and Truth-Teller: mirror telling brutal truth the protagonist refuses to hear.
The Flirt Duel: rhetorical sparring, intelligence and attraction; neither side surrenders.
The Valid Conflict: equally legitimate moral values collide; everyone is bleeding.
The Vulnerable Silence: fight drops, fewer words, more pauses; character stops performing.
The Grand Gesture Speech: no clichés; deeply seen the specific damage of the other person.
The Power Shift: dominance to equality to surrender; physical tools for emotional truth.
The Barrier Breaker: intimacy is bravery, capitulation, transgression, a new vulnerability.
The Consequence of Closeness: intimacy creates fear of loss; next internal conflict.
